create_EncodeText_with_base64: create an EncodeText augmenter using a Base64 encoder to encode text strings
create_EncodeText_with_leetspeak: create an EncodeText augmenter using a LeetSpeak encoder to obfuscate text strings
run_EncodeText_augmenter: run the EncodeText augmenter on a string or list of strings to encode them
review_EncodeText_init: review the EncodeText class constructor that accepts an EncodeTextAugmentation encoder
test_EncodeText_augmenter: test the EncodeText augmenter method with base64 or leetspeak encoding strategies
